THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
Area 17 · Old streambed bypass
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

A dry channel squeezes beneath a low ceiling. Smooth stones and rounded boulders mark the course water once followed through the dark.

Smooth stones lie among larger boulders in the dry channel. With the ceiling hanging low, the route asks you to watch both your footing and your head. Its bends and obstructions break the view ahead; you can keep track of the way back as you pass them.

Ask the players

Who scouts the narrow passage, how do you carry light, and how do you help anyone slowed by the space?
